headline: Minespine Build
title: Minespine Best Build | Seismic Wave and Stone Shell | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Minespine is an Earth Breaker, so go Break first. Run Seismic Wave, which deals damage every second, with Stone Shell, a quick stone shot. Its Earth Affinity trait lets it cast skills while tunneling and adds Break damage. Meteor Shower is the big finisher, and a Gargantuan Horn is the held item. Do you run Minespine? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Minespine is an Earth Breaker. Run Seismic Wave and Stone Shell, use Earth Affinity to cast while tunneling and hold a Gargantuan Horn.
